520huxiangli/Aharou.description: Aharou · AI assistant and Coding Agent on your phone (built-in Linux environment · Shadow Screen)
520huxiangli/Aharou.body:
AI assistant on your phone · Coding Agent · Built-in Linux environment

---

## Download and Install

- **Latest package**: Download `Aharou-*.apk` from the [Releases](https://github.com/520huxiangli/Aharou/releases/latest) page. Allow "Install unknown apps," then install it.
- Supports Android 8.0+ and does not require root. The built-in Linux environment initializes automatically on first launch.
- You configure all models, keys, and endpoints yourself. No models are bundled, and there is no provider lock-in.

## Introduction

Aharou packs a complete AI assistant and Linux environment into your phone. It includes a built-in Alpine container and a multi-tab terminal. The Agent can read and write files, run commands, and run builds. You can also switch the execution backend to a remote SSH host. Everything runs on the device itself, so you don't need a computer or have to set up your own environment.

## Features

- 🗨️ **AI chat**: Multiple providers and models, with Markdown, images, and display of the thinking process
- 🐧 **Built-in Linux environment**: Alpine (PRoot) with a multi-tab terminal. Supports importing custom images and mounting host directories
- 🌐 **Browser panel**: A built-in browser that the Agent can drive to open and operate pages
- 📁 **Sandboxed files**: File browser and previews (images / text / Markdown / audio / video / PDF / APK / archives)
- 🖥️ **Small screen**: Real-time visualization of tool execution, including line-by-line terminal output, web snapshots, and Shadow Screen live view
- 🪟 **Shadow Screen**: A headless virtual display. The Agent runs, takes screenshots, and operates apps on an "invisible screen" without disturbing your phone
- ⚙️ **Config channel**: The Agent can modify its own settings. Every write requires your confirmation, is fully audited, and can be rolled back with one click
- 🦊 **Persona (SOUL.md)**: Name, icon, language, and persona text. Edit at any time, and changes take effect immediately in chat
- 🔌 **Shizuku support**: Through Shizuku, the Agent can run commands at the system level and read and write other apps' private directories, without root
- 🔑 **Environment variables**: Custom variables stored encrypted and automatically injected into all commands and terminals in the container
- 🗄️ **Storage management**: View usage by category and clean up with one click
- 🧩 **More**: MCP, skills, sub-agents, themes and backgrounds, and more

H-Jett/etf-radar.description: Industry National Team ETF Radar · tracks ETFs and their shares held by Central Huijin, Huijin Asset Management, the National Council for Social Security Fund, and China Securities Finance Corporation (CSF), aggregated by industry (GitHub Pages static site, daily collection via GitHub Actions)
H-Jett/etf-radar.body:
# Industry National Team ETF Radar (GitHub Pages Edition)

Tracks China's "national team" (Central Huijin, Huijin Asset Management, the National Council for Social Security Fund, and China Securities Finance Corporation (中国证券金融)) by **industry / theme**, including the ETFs they hold, their shares, and changes in holding weight. **Purely static site, no server, no database**: GitHub Actions scrapes data on a daily schedule → generates JSON and commits it back to the repository → GitHub Pages hosts the frontend.

🔗 Online: **https://h-jett.github.io/etf-radar/**

> Inspired by [kitaki-Ciallo/etf-national-tracker](https://github.com/kitaki-Ciallo/etf-national-tracker) (Flask + PostgreSQL version). This project is refactored into **static hosting + industry-level aggregation + point-accurate history**.

## ✨ Features (4 pages)

- **Industry Overview** `index.html`: ranking of national team holding market value by industry, average weight, change from the previous period, and institutional distribution (table + bar chart + pie chart). At the top is a **today's collection status** module (✅/⚠️/❌ + latest heartbeat; expandable to view metrics and warnings).
- **Industry Trends** `trends.html`: daily share curves for total shares by industry (**day/week/month** toggle + drag), and reporting-period series for national team holding shares/weight, with a data table (first column frozen).
- **Industry Detail** `detail.html`: select an industry → multi-line chart of shares for **all member ETFs** plus a total line (legend checkboxes toggle visibility); a dropdown switches to view the **top ten holders of a single ETF**.
- **Collection Logs** `logs.html`: complete record of each run (paginated by month), showing at a glance whether each day was normal and the cause of any anomalies.

Interaction: the day/week/month selection and the dragged time range are **remembered via `localStorage` and shared across pages**. Charts are rendered locally (`js/vendor/echarts.min.js`, no CDN dependency).

## 🧭 Key Conventions (important to understand)

- **All times are Beijing time (UTC+8)**.
- **Shares are T+1**: ETF share data is disclosed the next day, so the "market day" is always **the previous trading day**; closing prices are aligned to that day (price and shares on the same day).
- **Holding weight / shares = reporting-period basis**: top ten holders are only disclosed in semi-annual and annual reports, with a maximum lag of about 6 months. Each historical period is **point-accurate**: only ETFs **actually held during that period** are counted (including those that have since exited), so the results are not underestimated by current members.
- **Holding market value** ≈ shares held in the reporting period × latest closing price. This is an approximation.

## 🗂️ Directory Structure

```
etf-nt-industry/
├── collector/                # Collection layer (pure requests, no pandas/bs4/DB)
│…
```

HZDavy/MoteDeck.body:
Feature requests and bug reports are welcome via [Issues](https://github.com/HZDavy/MoteDeck/issues), and you are also welcome to submit a [Pull Request](https://github.com/HZDavy/MoteDeck/pulls) directly. For usage instructions, see [Help](https://hzdavy.github.io/MoteDeck/help/).

> [!NOTE]
> Nearly all of this project's own code was developed with AI assistance and may contain oversights. We appreciate your understanding for any inconvenience this may cause.

MoteDeck is a Windows tool centered on voice control of a computer with a remote control. It supports the **Xiaomi Bluetooth Voice Remote 2 Pro** (RC003), the **Xiaomi Remote 2** (RC001), and the **Google Remote** (Chromecast) in the Google TV version. Google TV remotes are made by third parties in multiple versions, so compatibility with all versions cannot be guaranteed. Through button mapping and voice input, it turns the remote into a computer's keyboard shortcuts and microphone. After connecting OpenMexia, you can also use voice to control Mijia devices.

Buttons can be mapped to keyboard shortcuts (with optional driver-level injection), mouse actions, or launching applications. A single press, double press, and long press on the same button can each be assigned a separate action. The voice key can trigger an input method's voice shortcut, and it can also use the local SenseVoice model to recognize speech offline as text. After connecting OpenMexia, a single voice command can switch devices throughout the whole house.

A desktop version is provided for Windows 10 / 11 x64, with a single-window settings interface of three pages (Devices / Buttons / Voice). It stays in the notification area and supports launching at startup. Installers can be downloaded from [Releases](https://github.com/HZDavy/MoteDeck/releases). They are unsigned, so on first run, just handle any unready items following the prompts on the page.

The program runs entirely on your local machine and does not upload remote addresses, button logs, recordings, or personal data.

This project is a modified version of the Windows implementation of [`nijez/open-voice-bridge`](https://github.com/nijez/open-voice-bridge), licensed under GPL-3.0 (the historical repository for the Windows implementation is [`ZSTDJan/windows-remote-mic-app`](https://github.com/ZSTDJan/windows-remote-mic-app)). Upstream attribution, the scope of changes, and the GPL-3.0 §5(a) modification notice are in [ATTRIBUTION.md](https://github.com/HZDavy/MoteDeck/blob/HEAD/apps/windows/rc003/ATTRIBUTION.md). ## Workbench Web Preview 1（R1，发布准备中）

The first Web preview is limited to Windows 11 x64, a same-origin loopback Web interface, and a matching NativeAOT Server. Candidate 10 has completed local R1 hands-on acceptance and preparation of four attachments, but the product is still **NOT_READY**. The P07 gate and P08 authorized release are not yet complete, so this preview has no public download yet. You can evaluate bounded SQL, relational tables, measurements, and one authorized single-row insert. The seven dedicated model workbenches, Studio, and VS Code are postponed. [Usage, limitations, upgrade/rollback and feedback](https://github.com/IoTSharp/SonnetDB/blob/HEAD/docs/design/m47-unified-management-workbench/sonnetdb-workbench-web-4.5.0-preview.1.10-notes.md) and [independent distribution status](https://github.com/IoTSharp/SonnetDB/blob/HEAD/docs/design/m47-unified-management-workbench/preview-1-p06-distribution.md) describe the actual scope.

## 在线演示与测试账号

## Online Demo and Test Accounts

- Demo address: <https://iotsharp.online/sonnetdb/admin/login>
- Demo account: `demo@iotsharp.online`
- Demo password: `P@ssw0rd`

Only the username and password of the public demo account are reset every half hour. **Regular registered accounts can be used to test the service. Accounts, passwords, and business data do not take part in demo resets and are kept long-term.** The public demo account can only access the demo database.

## 🧩 SonnetDB 是什么

## 🧩 What SonnetDB Is

**SonnetDB is a multi-model data engine.**

It brings nine kinds of data capabilities, which usually require several separate systems to cover, into one engine: time series, relational tables, key-value, JSON documents, full-text search, vector search, object storage, message queues, and native property graphs. They are accessed through SQL, standard APIs, and management tools.

SonnetDB's core value is **unification**. The nine data models keep their own native semantics and access methods, share one service process, one permission entry point, and one management console, and work together within the same engine. Persistence and recovery still have model boundaries: database backups cover the resources in that database's directory. The Server's SonnetMQ lives in the instance-level `.system/mq` and is currently not included in single-database backups, so single-database recovery should not be treated as a consistent recovery across all nine models.

The deployment model is flexible. It can be embedded in a process as a library for direct use, or deployed as a standalone service, suitable for local applications, devices and edge nodes, business systems, private on-premises environments, and other scenarios.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

Ornn8/memory-system-benchmark.body:
# 大肥鱼 · Memory System Benchmark

What do the various memory frameworks actually remember, and what do they forget? This project organizes facts, changed statements, agreements, and boundaries from long-running chats into checkable questions, and uses one shared set of rules to compare different systems.

The project currently focuses on **ultra-light chat scenarios with about two rounds per day, spanning up to six months**. One round means one user message and one assistant reply. It does not represent high-frequency chat, multi-person group chat, or the full range of real-user usage.

**The formal six-character test set is now public: the complete synthetic histories, 714 formal questions, scoring criteria and evidence, and an offline question-reading tool.** A standalone single-character example is also kept; the example and the formal volume are not the same data.

## Results in Pictures

The latest set comprises **7 high-resolution images at 1800 × 2200 pixels**: test cost and overall scores for Suzu with forced native retrieval compared against Qwen, plus 5 grouped charts covering all 27 test points and comparing the same batch of 714 questions.

[View the seven Suzu and Qwen charts](https://github.com/Ornn8/memory-system-benchmark/blob/HEAD/charts/2026-11-05-suzu-forced/README.md) · [View the earlier seven-way shared-question chart collection](https://github.com/Ornn8/memory-system-benchmark/blob/HEAD/charts/2026-11-01/README.md)

## What Has Been Tested

**9 community projects/schemes, plus 1 Qwen RAG baseline**. The table below lists projects with published results. The full volume and the commonly answered question set cover different scopes, so for comparisons see the same-volume results in the links in each row.

Personal Mihomo / Clash Meta configuration, providing YAML, JS preprocessing scripts, and hand-drawn Qure-style SVG icons. No nodes or airport subscriptions are provided.

## 🚀 Usage

Click the copy button in the upper-right corner of the code block to copy the link.

### YAML Configuration

Can be imported directly into **FlClash's custom configuration**:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aaANDkk/ClashConfig/main/mihomo.yaml
```

Alternatively, download [mihomo.yaml](https://github.com/aaANDkk/ClashConfig/blob/HEAD/mihomo.yaml), fill in your own subscription link under `proxy-providers`, and then import it.

### JS Preprocessing Script

In clients that support subscription JS preprocessing, add [mihomo.js](https://github.com/aaANDkk/ClashConfig/blob/HEAD/mihomo.js); remote script link:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aaANDkk/ClashConfig/main/mihomo.js
```

## ✨ Highlights

- **Business routing**: AI, Google, GitHub, Telegram, anime, and streaming media have separate groups, combined with manual selection and background automatic speed testing.
- **Dynamic region groups**: The JS supports 51 common regions. A region group is generated once there are **3** manually visible nodes, and one is generated for residential (home broadband) with **1** node. Direct connections are also counted and kept in the manual group, excluded only from automatic speed testing. YAML uses fixed groups.
- **Private DNS**: The JS automatically extracts private DNS from the subscription, retaining node domain resolution policies and Hosts mappings.
- **Block switches**: `AdBlock`, `WebRTC`, and `QUIC` default to `Reject`; they can be switched to `Pass` to temporarily allow traffic. Includes some PCDN blocking rules.

The JS only counts nodes passed in by the client and does not proactively download remote providers. Nodes not separately grouped can still be selected in `All Proxies`. For supplementary rules, see [anime](https://github.com/aaANDkk/ClashConfig/blob/HEAD/rules/anime.yaml) / [media](https://github.com/aaANDkk/ClashConfig/blob/HEAD/rules/media.yaml).

alicia1030su/dsh-ai-debate.body: # AI Debate · dsh-ai-debate A DSH plugin that reads Baidu Tieba posts and their sub-replies (楼中楼), reconstructs the argument between the owner and the opponent, drafts a reply in the selected persona, and publishes it **only after the owner confirms**. > Scope: this plugin is about making points clear and surfacing supporting evidence. It does not threaten, personally attack, fabricate claims, organize pile-ons, or spam. Publishing defaults to **manual review**; every reply must be read in full by the owner and explicitly confirmed. --- ## Table of Contents - [What it actually does](#它到底能做什么) - [Platform support status](#平台支持现状) - [Four personas](#四种人格) - [Requirements](#环境要求) - [Installation](#安装) - [Configuration](#配置) - [Usage workflow](#使用流程) - [Nine tools](#九个工具) - [Reply review and publishing](#回复的审核与发布) - [Architecture and module layout](#架构与模块划分) - [How to develop a new platform adapter](#如何开发新的平台适配器) - [Development, testing, and packaging](#开发测试与打包) - [FAQ](#常见问题) - [Known limitations](#已知限制) - [Updating and uninstalling](#更新与卸载) - [License](#许可证) --- ## What it actually does The owner (that's you, in the post) has gotten into an argument with someone on Tieba, and you want an AI alt account to carry the argument forward for you. Typical flow: 1. You give the plugin a post link, or a link that includes the ID of the reply you want to summon. 2. The plugin reads **every page** of the entire thread (not just the first page), and also reads all the **sub-replies (楼中楼)** under the relevant floors. 3. It uses rules (not guesses from a model) to determine: who the subject is, who you are arguing with, which floor the argument takes place on, how the argument chain unfolds, and which of the opponent's questions remain unanswered. 4. It compresses the context to a budget a small model can handle (default 2000 tokens), then has the persona engine and model generate one candidate reply. 5. The program runs hard checks on the candidate: whether it targets the right person, whether it's too long, whether it leaks credentials or prompts, and whether it duplicates something posted earlier. 6. Candidates that pass are handed to you. The plugin only actually sends a reply after you review it, confirm it, and invoke publishing; after publishing, it re-reads the thread to confirm the reply really went out. **What it explicitly does not do**: guess. When context is insufficient, the model is allowed (and encouraged) to answer `needs_more_context`. When the opponent can't be determined, the status becomes `NEEDS_CONFIRMATION` and waits for your decision, rather than picking someone at random to rebut. --- ## Platform support status | Platform | Status | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | Baidu Tieba | ✅ **Implemented; end-to-end real publishing not yet complete** | Post /…

danything/denpa.body:
# denpa

The documentation is also available at **[danything.github.io/denpa](https://danything.github.io/denpa/)**.

**A home TV recording server that works right away once you plug in a tuner and start it.**
No config files are needed. The tuner type (terrestrial / satellite) is detected automatically, so you just press scan on the screen.
Mirakurun, EDCB, and media servers are not required. Make reservations from the program guide, commercials are skipped automatically,
and you can watch both live and recorded programs in the browser with subtitles and data broadcasts. For TV, use the dedicated app
[denpa-tv](https://github.com/danything/denpa-tv).

If you are upgrading from 1.x, first read [what changed in 2.0](https://github.com/danything/denpa/blob/HEAD/docs/v2.md) (screen locations and removed settings).

For the other screens (program guide, clips, search, rules, settings), see [docs/screens.md](https://github.com/danything/denpa/blob/HEAD/docs/screens.md).

## Scope of use

denpa is for recording and watching **with your own B-CAS card, within your own household, for private use**.

- Do not show recordings or live streams to people outside your household
- Do not distribute the card's keys to devices outside your household
- Do not rewrite the card

The client (browser) connects directly to outside services only for live commentary, and only if you turn it on in settings. It connects to NX-Jikkyo and the Niconico Jikkyo past-log API. Those services can see the client's IP address and which channel is being watched and when ([docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/danything/denpa/blob/HEAD/docs/architecture.md#端末が外へ繋ぐもの-実況のコメント)).
In live view you can post comments to NX-Jikkyo. Posts are made public and cannot be deleted ([docs/watch.md](https://github.com/danything/denpa/blob/HEAD/docs/watch.md#実況に書き込む)).

The reasoning is summarized in [Discussion #760](https://github.com/danything/denpa/discussions/760). This is an organized basis for discussion, not legal advice.

danything/denpa-font.body:
# Denpa Font

A monospace rounded gothic font covering the characters used in broadcast subtitles, data broadcasts, and program listings: JIS X 0213 planes 1 and 2, ARIB external characters, and so on. It is made by mechanically rounding the corners of BIZ UDGothic (Morisawa). ARIB symbols that do not exist in the original are drawn with parts from BIZ UDGothic.

- Family name `Denpa Font` (PostScript name `DenpaFont-Regular`), em 1024, with advance widths of only half-width 512 and full-width 1024
- The character set is taken from the table at [danything/denpa](https://github.com/danything/denpa), and all of it is included (11,709 characters in v3.6. The web font is split into the basic 8,128 characters and the 3,581 kanji added by JIS X 0213). It has no vertical writing and no hinting. It has `palt`, which tightens full-width alphanumerics, and `ccmp`, which composes two-codepoint characters such as か゚ into one glyph ([docs/design.md](https://github.com/danything/denpa-font/blob/HEAD/docs/design.md#palt-全角の英数字を詰める))

## Download

From [Releases](https://github.com/danything/denpa-font/releases).

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `denpa-font.ttf` | TrueType (fontconfig, Android, etc.). One file for all characters |
| `denpa-font.woff2` | Web font (browsers). Basic characters: JIS X 0208, ARIB external characters, non-kanji characters such as JIS X 0213 symbols and kana, and composed characters such as か゚ |
| `denpa-font-jisx0213.woff2` | Web font (browsers). Kanji added by JIS X 0213 (levels 3 and 4). Uses the same family name as the basic file, with a `unicode-range` so the browser uses it for those characters |
| `denpa-font-jisx0213.txt` | Character range of `denpa-font-jisx0213.woff2` (the value for CSS `unicode-range`, one line) |
| `SHA256SUMS` | sha256 checksums of the 4 files above |

The web font is split into two files. Browsers fetch `denpa-font-jisx0213.woff2` only when kanji added by JIS X 0213 appear on the page.

joylyboy/douyin-live-monitor.body:
# Douyin Live Room Start/Stop Monitor

Automatically monitors a batch of Douyin live rooms. Whenever a room goes live or ends its stream, it sends a push notification to iPhone via Bark. Tapping the notification opens the corresponding live room directly in Douyin through its URL Scheme (`snssdk1128://live`).

## How It Works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[External timer / GitHub Actions trigger] --> B[Run monitor.py]
    B --> C[Read rooms.txt]
    C --> D[Request live.douyin.com/room one by one]
    D --> E{Page contains m3u8/flv stream address?}
    E -- Yes --> F[Judged live]
    E -- No --> G[Judged offline]
    F & G --> H[Compare with last state]
    H --> I[Send Bark if state changed]
    I --> J[Tap notification to open Douyin live room]
```

Detection basis: the `liveStatus` field in Douyin's web SSR data also returns `normal` for rooms that are live, so it is unreliable. However, offline room pages contain zero real stream addresses such as `m3u8/flv/pull_url`, while live rooms contain many. Therefore, “the page contains real stream addresses” is used as the reliable signal for live status. If the page cannot be fetched or an error occurs, no notification is sent in that run (to prevent false positives).

## File Overview

- `monitor.py` — main program: reads rooms.txt, detects go-live, sends Bark notifications, writes state.json.
- `rooms.txt` — the monitoring list. Only this file needs editing; no need to touch monitor.py.
- `state.json` — runtime state (last live status), maintained automatically by the program and added to .gitignore.
- `add_room.ps1` — script for adding rooms from the local command line, independent of this tool (see below).
- `add_room.py` — Python version of the same function (backup).
- `.github/workflows/douyin-monitor.yml` — GitHub Actions workflow (native schedule as a fallback).

## rooms.txt Format

One room per line, in the form “link or identifier, display name” separated by a comma:

    https://live.douyin.com/125093611494, Teacher Zicheng's Family Education Talks
    https://v.douyin.com/1_AyxhJoFkc/, Yuchuan E-commerce

- The display name can be omitted (short links automatically look up the nickname using sec_uid).
- Supported formats:
  - Numeric room ID / Douyin ID (username)
  - `live.douyin.com/room-ID`
  - `v.douyin.com/xxxx`…

ling-kong-ran/pisper.description: Multi-agent app for parallel sessions, tools, memory, workflows, desktop, terminal, and mobile.
ling-kong-ran/pisper.body:
A multi-agent application spanning desktop, terminal, and mobile: the idea of managing agents the way you manage code branches, branching off from any completed Turn and advancing in parallel.

## ✨ Why Pisper

- **Conversations can branch too.** Spin off a new session from any completed Turn, inheriting its context while leaving the source session untouched. Stable Turn tags pin key milestones as searchable anchors. It's like Git, but for agents.
- **Truly parallel multi-agent work.** Each session has its own model, context, working directory, and permissions. Drag tabs to split the screen into four panes, with progress visible side by side.
- **Clear separation of hot and cold tools.** Core tools stay resident in context. Plugins, MCP servers, and skills are activated on demand through the discover/call gateway and deactivated once used, so capabilities can grow without turning the context into a junk room.
- **Stable prefixes keep the cache hot.** Tool definitions are sorted in a stable order, and prompt shapes are diagnosed with hashing, maximizing use of the provider's prompt cache. Long sessions become faster and cheaper.
- **Just say what's missing.** Pisper can write, validate, and install a local plugin itself, ready to be called in the next turn of conversation.
- **Works standalone on mobile, and connects to desktop.** The Android / iOS apps bundle the same Node/Pisper Runtime, standard sessions, and React UI as the desktop, and disable entry points the device cannot support. You can also scan a QR code to connect to a desktop, preferring LAN and automatically falling back to Iroh P2P when away from the local network. Remote links continue to use TLS fingerprints and device Bearer tokens.
- **Data stays on your machine by default.** The Runtime listens only on 127.0.0.1 by default, sensitive formats are automatically redacted, and memories are reviewed before use. Your context, your call.

## 🗺️ Capability Map

| 🌿 Parallel & Forking | 🧩 Capability Extensions |
| --- | --- |
| Split-screen parallel sessions · Recall branch tree · Stable Turn tags · Per-turn file rollback · Ctrl+K cross-session jump · Session-level model/directory/permissions · Persistent permission rules for commands and files | Auto-generated local plugins · Connect external MCP services · Built-in MCP service for other local agents · Skill center · Multi-provider model configuration · Automatic fallback to backup model when the primary is unavailable |
| **⚡ Automation & Notifications** | **🖥️ Unified Terminal & Desktop** |
| Visual workflows · Scheduled tasks · Two-way Feishu / personal WeChat channels · Xingyi project memory · Git and SVN workspaces | Ratatui TUI and desktop share the Runtime · Android / iOS same-source local Runtime or desktop connection · Desktop pet (Petdex) · Desktop / TUI / Runtime / App update independently |

Want other agents on the same computer to call Pisper? Enable the built-in service yourself on the MCP page and copy the connection config. It supports sessions, memory, workflows, and more; connecting requires a token.

lznauy/NekoCode.description: Terminal AI companion, more than just a terminal. Continuously iterating.
lznauy/NekoCode.body:
# NekoCode

---

NekoCode is an open-source **AI programming workbench**. You can describe what you need directly, and it will read the project, modify code, run commands, and verify the results. Larger tasks can be handed to multiple sub-agents that proceed in parallel, and the process, usage, and file changes can all be viewed.

Daily use starts with a terminal program and a model configuration. When you need more capability, you can gradually add Skill, Plugin, MCP, and Hook, or connect the same Agent foundation to an editor, IM, or your own application.

## Why it's good to use

### Smooth interaction, clear process

The TUI supports streaming responses, Markdown display, command completion, and menu selection. Running status, tool activity, file changes, and task progress are shown in one place, and approvals and questions are handled in the current interface. When you scroll up to read history, your position is preserved; press `End` to return to the latest content. When you need to change direction, you can interrupt or add instructions while it's running.

Press `Ctrl+G` or type `/tasks` to open the sub-task center, where you can view execution status, historical rounds, final results, and paginated large outputs. The main conversation keeps a progress summary, and detailed process can be expanded on demand, which makes it easier to follow multiple tasks running at the same time.

### Lightweight installation, configuration starts with the model

The TUI is released as a single executable, and basic use requires no deployment of frontend or database services. After installation, enter your API Key, model ID, and service address to get started. Model switching, session selection, permissions, and extension management all have command entry points.

Project conventions are written in `NEKOCODE.md`, and project-level and user-level extensions are managed separately. Skills with the same name are selected by an explicit priority order, and project customizations can travel with the project. MCP services, language servers, and image models are configured separately as needed.

### Long sessions load on demand, controlling memory growth

The current context and the full conversation history are stored separately. History is appended to disk, viewed by paginated index, and when a session is restored, only the context currently needed is read. Run records and history caches have budgets, and large tool outputs are handled through file references and paginated reads. This reduces the pressure of repeatedly loading all history into memory during long-term use.

Automatic summarization and `/compact` reduce the active context sent to the model, while the full history can still be viewed and exported. Actual memory usage depends on context size, enabled extensions, and external tool processes. These mechanisms focus on controlling resource growth in long sessions.

### Centralized prompts, workflows loaded on demand

The [core prompt](https://github.com/lznauy/NekoCode/blob/HEAD/bot/prompt/system_zh.md) centrally defines general collaboration rules, making it easy to read and modify. Project conventions are provided through `NEKOCODE.md`. Specialized workflows such as troubleshooting, planning, and review live in Skills, and their full text is loaded only when needed. You can also explicitly specify one with `$技能名`.

### Designed for high cache hit rates to save input costs

Multi-turn programming tasks repeatedly carry project instructions, tool definitions, and historical context, and this portion often makes up the bulk of the input. NekoCode…

# Pocket Harness：安卓上的 Agent 壳

[English](https://github.com/snoworwind/pocket-harness/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · [下载最新版本](https://github.com/snoworwind/pocket-harness/releases/latest)

Pocket Harness 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 Android 壳。它把 WebView 界面与 Termux 运行时快照打包在同一个 APK 中，让 Agent 能在手机上使用 bash 和设备能力，无需另装 Termux。

## 能做什么

- **运行 Agent**：内嵌 Linux 运行时，提供 bash、Node.js 和项目插件。
- **操作手机**：通过无障碍与 Shizuku 通道读取界面、执行输入和截屏。
- **浏览网页**：使用与主界面隔离的浏览器工作台管理网页和标签页。
- **使用虚拟屏**：在独立虚拟显示屏中运行和操作第三方应用（需要 Shizuku）。
- **处理文件**：通过系统文件选择器、分享入口和 SAF 目录桥将文件交给会话。

模型可见的能力由插件提供，壳侧不直接注册工具。详细接口和能力清单见[桥协议](https://github.com/snoworwind/pocket-harness/blob/HEAD/docs/AGENTS/BRIDGE-API.md)及各插件说明。

## 下载与安装

从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/snoworwind/pocket-harness/releases/latest) 下载当前公开版本。安装包架构、升级方式和验收范围以该版本的 Release 说明为准。

```sh
adb install -r -t <apk>
```

APK ABI 必须与设备匹配；x86_64 模拟器不受支持。首次启动或覆盖安装后，运行时快照需要解压数分钟，请等待完成，期间不要强行停止应用。虚拟屏和特权 shell 功能需要安装并授权 Shizuku。

插件市场中的第三方插件尚未普遍完成手机适配，可能无法使用或存在问题；请不要把它们当作生产依赖。

## 构建

APK 只能通过源码来源链构建；仅构建 ARM64。云端构建：

```sh
gh workflow run build-apk-source.yml --repo snoworwind/pocket-harness --ref main
```

txp666/FluentQtWidgets.description: A Fluent Design-style C++/Qt Widgets control library with reusable controls, examples, Gallery, and OTA release support.
txp666/FluentQtWidgets.body:
FluentQtWidgets is a Fluent Design-style control library for C++/Qt Widgets. It includes reusable controls, standalone examples, and a complete Gallery application.

This project is the **C++/Qt Widgets port** of the Python [PyQt-Fluent-Widgets](https://github.com/zhiyiYo/PyQt-Fluent-Widgets). The original Python version is the behavioral and visual baseline for this repository. Control states, spacing, QSS constants, example content, resource paths, Gallery page structure, and translations are aligned with the upstream implementation wherever possible. Necessary adjustments are kept only where Qt/C++ platform behavior differs.

## Interface Preview

## Features

- **200+ controls and components**: various buttons (theme-colored, dropdown, split, toggle, pill, hyperlink), checkboxes, radio buttons, switches, sliders, combo boxes, input boxes, number boxes, date and time pickers, navigation bars, Pivot, segmented controls, breadcrumbs and tabs, list, table, and tree views, dialogs, Flyout, TeachingTip, rounded menus and command bars, InfoBar, badges, progress bars and progress rings, settings cards, and media playback bar and video controls (requires Qt Multimedia).
- **Native charts**: `ChartWidget` uses ECharts-like JSON configuration to draw bar, line, area, ring, scatter, radar, gauge, and heatmap charts. `RealtimePlotWidget` suits high-density real-time data streams, and `AudioWaveformWidget` is a waveform control.
- **Themes**: light, dark, or follow the system. Theme color is customizable, and all of these can be switched at runtime. Custom controls can use `FluentStyleSheet::setCustomStyleSheet()` to provide one stylesheet for each of the two themes.
- **Windows and materials**: borderless `FluentWindow`, `MSFluentWindow`, and `SplitFluentWindow`; Mica background on Windows 11; acrylic material for menus, flyouts, input boxes, and tips.
- **170+ Fluent icons**, automatically adapting to light and dark themes.
- **Multilingual**: built-in Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese translations.
- **Complete examples**: 75 individually runnable examples, plus a full Gallery application that can check for updates.
- **Cross-platform**: Windows, macOS, and Linux, with continuous integration on all three platforms.

## Quick Start

After building and installing, reference it in your CMake project:

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets)
find_package(FluentQtWidgets CONFIG REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(my_app PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets…

zheng0625/Clash-Studio.description: Clash Studio: a Windows / Linux Mihomo client centered on visual subscription editing and modular, precise traffic routing, with a Liquid Glass style, a floating Dock, and customizable themes.
zheng0625/Clash-Studio.body:
**Clash Studio is a Windows / Linux Mihomo desktop client centered on visual subscription editing, modular management, and precise traffic routing, while also balancing interface design and daily usage experience.**

It connects the source subscription, personal modifications, routing modules, and the core's runtime configuration. First, organize nodes, policy groups, and rules, then hand traffic for different domains, application processes, and IP subnets to the designated outbound. The interface uses Liquid Glass-style layering, a floating Dock, and a unified card layout, giving complex configurations clear entry points for action.

## Precise routing: every rule has a clear destination

- **Match by domain, domain suffix, process name, process path, and IPv4 / IPv6 subnet**, and assign a policy group or outbound to each module.
- **Modular composition**: reuse modules across different subscription profiles, enable or disable them separately, and adjust their order. Module rules take precedence over source subscription rules.
- **Strict outbound review**: inspects visible nested policy chains, and rejects chains that can reach DIRECT, missing or circular references, and dynamic members that cannot be fully inspected.
- **Verifiable results**: on the Connections page, view the rules, policy chains, and traffic that Mihomo actually matched, and check whether routing behaves as expected.

“Precise” means controlling traffic already taken over by the core through explicit match conditions and rule priority. Actual coverage depends on the system proxy, TUN, process identification, and network environment. Strict review does not guarantee a fixed public IP, and there is currently no firewall kill-switch protection after the core exits.

## Real-device verification: precise routing and DNS leak prevention

The following are three IPLeak real-device screenshots provided by the user; test status was confirmed by the tester. The images have been cropped, and IPv4 / IPv6 addresses, DNS server addresses, and mDNS local host identifiers are masked with opaque blocks. The region, carrier, and detection count shown by the website are retained for comparison.

| Test status | Public IP / WebRTC | DNS detection result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Proxy not enabled | Shows China Unicom exit; the web page detects IPv4 and IPv6, and WebRTC shows the local carrier's public IP | Page reports 19 servers and 37 tests; the visible list is domestic carriers |
| TUN on, DNS leak prevention off | Web and WebRTC both show a Singapore exit; IPv6 test is unreachable | Page reports 23 servers and 5 tests; the visible list mixes China Unicom and Singapore servers |
| DNS leak prevention on / precise routing result example | Web and WebRTC both show a Singapore exit; IPv6 test is unreachable | Page reports 12 servers and 7 tests; the DNS servers listed in the screenshot are all labeled Singapore, Amazon |

**Proxy off: establishing a local network baseline.** The web page and WebRTC show the local carrier's public exit, and the DNS list also shows a domestic carrier. This serves as the baseline for later comparison.

**TUN on, leak prevention off: after the exit switches, DNS may still use the local carrier.** This time, the web visit and WebRTC already showed the Singapore exit, but the DNS list still included China Unicom servers, which shows that the web page's public IP alone …
